scope: Read-only CPU and thermal inspection; no causation experiment performed.
followup_sample: In a subsequent approximately 20-second sample, earlier peaks subsided. Several other processes showed moderate CPU activity. The installed-app inventory is omitted from public evidence.
conclusion: Transient load in several other apps is observed, but no individual app is established as the cause of the earlier thermal job stops. The live/cached thermal-state discrepancy is a stronger lead for the ongoing restriction.
